main_body: palm tree with frond canopy and segmented trunk
top_band: upper surface of the palm frond crown (green/light-green rows 1-11)
evidence: The palm tree shows the top surface of its frond crown (rows 1-11) with a bright top highlight around rows 5-6, overhanging and casting shadow (rows 11-12) onto the segmented vertical trunk below (rows 12-39).

style.evidence: The candidate has a uniform heavy pure/near-black 1px outline around the entire silhouette (fronds and trunk), giving it a harsh sticker-like appearance compared to the Beodeul reference trees which use dark green and dark brown material-toned outlines selectively. The fronds and trunk segments are also much simpler and more banded/geometric than the organic clustered detailing on the reference trees.
